name: Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Exempt Entry Authorization

requirements.blocker_text: Embassy of Haiti (Canada): citizens of countries with a visa exemption (Canada among them) do not need to arrange a visa in advance for stays under 90 days -- entry authorization is granted on arrival by Haitian immigration authorities at the port of entry. Others must apply in advance through a Haitian consular section: a tourist visa runs $100 for 3 months or $200 for a 6-month multiple-entry version (Embassy of Haiti, Washington DC fee schedule), requiring a passport valid 6+ months beyond travel, a completed application with photo, and payment by certified check or money order (cash and personal checks are not accepted). Long-stay visas and permanent residence are handled separately by Haiti's own Direction de l'Immigration et de l'Emigration (DIE), not the visa desk.
requirements.fix_path: Visa-exempt nationalities get entry authorization on arrival for stays under 90 days; others must apply for a tourist visa at a Haitian consular section before travel.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid 6+ months beyond travel dates

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days; a long-stay permit (permis de sejour) becomes mandatory before the 90-day period expires for anyone staying longer, except persons of Haitian descent

sources.title: Embassy of Haiti, Canada (official diplomatic mission) -- visa categories, exemptions, fees, 90-day long-stay-permit deadline
Embassy of Haiti, Washington DC (official diplomatic mission) -- tourist visa fee schedule

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Haiti). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced to two of Haiti's own diplomatic missions, tier 1. GENUINE FINDING: the long-stay permit's ANNUAL renewal cycle runs 1 October to 30 September regardless of when it was first issued -- a fixed fiscal-year-style window rather than an anniversary-of-issuance renewal, per the Canada embassy source. Haiti's Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own consular pages, and a general visa-free nationality list comparable to what other countries in this dataset show, were not independently located -- most consular sources describe only fees and the exemption/on-arrival mechanism rather than a full country list; this file models what was confirmed rather than inferring a complete list. switchable_to left populated since the SAME permis de sejour process (see ht_work_permit.json, ht_investor_residence.json, ht_family_reunification.json) is what a visitor converts to before the 90-day window closes.
